description.es-ES: Compendio de doctrina cristiana que Fray Luis de Granada escribió en portugués (Lisboa 1559), en la versión castellana del P. Justo Cuervo (1906): la fe, los mandamientos, la oración y los sacramentos en tres partes y los sermones. El original portugués no se ha hallado en texto.
description.en-US: The Compendium of Christian Doctrine that Fray Luis de Granada wrote in Portuguese (Lisbon 1559), in the Spanish version of Fr. Justo Cuervo (1906): faith, commandments, prayer and the sacraments in three parts with the sermons. The Portuguese original has not been found as text.
description.pt-BR: O Compêndio de doutrina cristã que Frei Luís de Granada escreveu em português (Lisboa 1559), na versão castelhana do P. Justo Cuervo (1906): a fé, os mandamentos, a oração e os sacramentos em três partes e os sermões. O original português não foi encontrado em texto.

sources.edition: Fr. Luis de Granada, Obras, ed. Justo Cuervo OP, vol. 13 (Madrid: Viuda e hija de Gómez Fuentenebro, 1906-1908). Translation made by Cuervo from the Portuguese original.
sources.description: Cuervo's Spanish translation of the Portuguese Compendio de doutrina christãa; tables and notes are not imported. OCR of the University of Toronto scan, cleaned by script (running heads, page numbers and the editor's prologue removed; lost initial capitals restored from the corpus vocabulary), not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Granada's text of the 16th century, reprinted in 1906; Cuervo's edition is in the public domain on archive.org.
